matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 241-250 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. Repeated or near-matching rows remain distinct, including Edward P/R/R Jr. Kast; Kauffman, Kaufman, Kaufmann, and Kaufmannn spelling groups; same-name Stanley Kazinauskas rows in boxes 394 and 392; Kelley and Kelly name variants; William G Kemp and William G Kemp Jr.; same-name and near-name Kennedy rows; Kessler and King common-name clusters; and two Eugene Kingman rows with different rank, identifier occupancy, and notes. The review preserves truncated printed notes and locations, literal capitalization and misspellings such as Thoams Karamessines, Vincent. Jr. Katilius, Kaydoough, Robery Kehoe, Ricahrd Kellam, Arthus Keller, Kennely, Kiblerm, Toshiniro, and Florend Kindell; foreign and service notes; out-of-sequence boxes and locations; and column shifts exactly as printed. The repeated Kelley/ Kelly John F rows share the same private identifier and are reserved for identity review rather than silently merged. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
